name: xAI (Grok)
summary: Grok language models with server-side web and X search, image generation and model listings through the xAI API.

api_key.description: an xAI API key (console.x.ai, API Keys)

notes: Responses (/v1/responses) is the current API; Chat Completions is the OpenAI-compatible predecessor xAI keeps for existing integrations.

Web and X search are server-side tools passed in 'tools' on /v1/responses ({"type": "web_search"} or {"type": "x_search"}); the model decides how many searches to run, so cost scales with the question.
Tool calls are billed on top of tokens: web_search $5 per 1k calls; x_search $5 per 1k posts and $10 per 1k profiles fetched (per pricing page, 2026-11).
Sampling: temperature above 1 is sampled at 1 and top_p above the model default (0.95) is sampled at the default.

endpoints.name: Check the API key
endpoints.summary: Name, status, ACLs and team of the API key making the call.

endpoints.name: List language models
endpoints.summary: Chat and image-understanding models this key can use, with modalities, aliases and per-token prices.

endpoints.name: Generate a response (with optional web and X search)
endpoints.summary: Run a Grok model on an input, optionally letting it search the web and X through server-side tools, and get the answer with citations.

model.description: Model name, from the models list.

input.description: A string, or a list of {role, content} messages.

example.content: What are people saying about SpaceX on X this week?

instructions.description: System prompt; cannot be combined with previous_response_id.

tools.description: Tools the model may call: function tools, {"type": "web_search", "filters": {"allowed_domains"|"excluded_domains": [max 5]}, "enable_image_understanding"}, or {"type": "x_search", "allowed_x_handles"|"excluded_x_handles": [max 20, no @], "from_date", "to_date" (YYYY-MM-DD), "enable_image_understanding", "enable_video_understanding"}.

max_output_tokens.description: Cap on visible output tokens; default 128,000.

store.description: Store the input and response for later retrieval.

notes: A read over POST. Spends tokens, plus per-call search fees when the model uses web_search or x_search.
allowed_domains and excluded_domains cannot be set together; neither can allowed_x_handles and excluded_x_handles.

endpoints.name: Get a stored response
endpoints.summary: A response created with store enabled, by id.

endpoints.name: Create a chat completion
endpoints.summary: OpenAI-compatible chat completion over a list of messages.

max_completion_tokens.description: Cap on visible output tokens; default 128,000. max_tokens is deprecated.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort; supported values depend on the model.

deferred.description: Return a request_id now and fetch the result later from /v1/chat/deferred-completion/{request_id}.

notes: A read over POST; spends tokens. Prefer xai.responses.create for search tools.

endpoints.name: Generate images
endpoints.summary: Images from a text prompt with a Grok Imagine model.

prompt.example: A red fox in fresh snow, photorealistic

deferred.description: Return a request_id at once and poll xai.images.get; only response_format url.

notes: Spends credits at Imagine API rates per image.
With deferred, poll GET /v1/images/{request_id}: 202 while pending, 200 with data (or an error body) when done.

endpoints.name: Get a deferred image result
endpoints.summary: Poll a deferred image generation or edit: 202 while pending, 200 with data or an error when finished.

request_id.description: The request_id from a deferred image request.
